# FlatBuffers C++ runtime

The headers `flatbuffers/flatbuffers.h` needs, unmodified, from
[google/flatbuffers](https://github.com/google/flatbuffers) v25.12.19 (Apache License 2.0, in
`LICENSE`). They are the runtime the C++ that flatc 25.12.19 generates requires, for C++ hosts
such as the Unreal plugin. Update them together with flatc and the Rust `flatbuffers` crate.
